text: dsh-skill-manager 是面向 DSH 桌面版的技能管理插件，通过侧边栏面板和宿主 API 展示已扫描的 skill 根目录、技能来源、有效性及无效 frontmatter 提示。用户可以创建带有名称、描述和正文的 SKILL.md，从文件夹导入技能，并在系统文件管理器中打开目录。它补充文件管理界面，不负责技能扫描或热加载；适合希望在桌面端查看和维护本地 DSH skills 的用户。需要官方桌面版，文件操作落在本机 DSH_HOME 下，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-skill-manager adds a DSH desktop sidebar for viewing local skill roots, sources, validity, and parsing errors. It can create SKILL.md files, import folders, and open skill locations. The runtime scans and reloads skills. Requires DSH desktop and local DSH_HOME; no API key.
想在桌面界面查看 DSH 扫描到哪些技能目录和技能是否有效。
能不能从文件夹导入本地 skill，省得手动复制到技能目录？
I want a desktop panel to create and inspect local DSH skills.
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「创建技能」：在桌面面板填写名称、描述和正文，插件会在 DSH_HOME/skills 下生成包含 SKILL.md 的技能目录；名称需符合小写 kebab-case。
dsh-skill-manager 的功能「查看技能」：侧边栏打开技能面板后，可查看扫描根目录、技能来源与有效性，并可从文件夹导入技能或打开其本机位置。

[English](./README.en.md) | **简体中文**

为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 桌面版提供 skill（技能）管理界面：列出宿主实际扫描的 skill 根目录、
标注每个 skill 的来源与有效性、新建 skill、从文件夹导入、在系统文件管理器中打开目录。

本插件以独立 bundle 形式装入 DSH profile，不接管官方 skill 的扫描与热加载。

dsh-skill-manager README · 问题背景：官方桌面版已具备完整的 skill 能力，但没有任何可视化入口：

| 能力 | 提供方 | 是否随官方发行 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 扫描 skill 根、解析 frontmatter、热加载 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` | 是 |
| `/` 唤起 skill | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skill` | 是 |
| 列出扫描到的根、标记无效文件、新建与导入 | —— | **否** |

因此当 frontmatter 写错、或 skill 没有被加载时，用户只能自己去翻目录与日志。

本插件补的就是这一层：它不参与加载，只在文件层面做增删查，并如实展示宿主扫描的根目录
与每个 skill 的来源。因此它与官方插件同时启用不会冲突 —— 一个负责装载，一个负责文件。

dsh-skill-manager README · 卸载：```bash
cd "<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop"
"$NODE" "$PNPM" remove dsh-skill-manager
```

随后从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中删除 `"dsh-skill-manager"` 一行。卸载后同样需要重启桌面版。

卸载**不会**删除任何 skill 文件：本插件只向 `<DSH_HOME>/skills` 写入，从不清理该目录。

dsh-skill-manager README · 工作原理：插件由两个半边组成，各自独立运行：

| 半边 | 运行位置 | 形态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宿主半边 | DSH 宿主进程（Node.js） | Cordis 插件，导出 `name` / `inject` / `apply(ctx)` |
| 客户端半边 | 桌面版窗口（浏览器） | React 页面，经 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 装载 |

**宿主半边**在 `ctx.webServer` 上注册**一条** `kind: 'prefix'` 路由
`/dsh-skill-manager/api`，前缀内部的路由派发由 `host/router.mjs` 完成。
这样做的好处是注册点只有一处，卸载时由框架统一清理，不会在 webServer 中留下半张路由表。

所有响应统一为 `{ ok: true, data }` 或 `{ ok: false, error }`，业务失败也返回 HTTP 200 ——
状态码只用于表达「路由不存在」这类传输层事实。

dsh-skill-manager README · 工作原理：**客户端半边**在首次请求时探测宿主基址。页面的来源可能是宿主自身的 HTTP 地址、
外壳的自定义 scheme（`dsh-app://app/`），也可能是不透明来源（`location.origin === "null"`）。
因此它按顺序尝试相对路径与官方虚拟主机名 `http://dsh.internal`，并以 `/info` 返回的
`data.plugin` 是否等于本插件 id 作为判定依据 —— 仅凭 HTTP 200 不够，SPA 的兜底路由
会把未知路径也返回 200 + HTML。选定后缓存复用。

**共享配置**：本插件与同系列的其他插件共用 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-extras.json`，
通过 `GET /config` 读取、`POST /config` 深合并写回。本插件不定义自己的配置项，
但 `GET /info` 会带上其中的 `appName` 字段。

dsh-skill-manager README · 工作原理：**日志**：宿主半边的日志写入 `<DSH_HOME>/plugin-data/logs/dsh-skill-manager.log`，
同时在内存中保留最近 2000 行环形缓冲。

dsh-skill-manager README · 界面与操作：侧边栏的「Skill 管理」入口打开面板，包含四项操作：

| 操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 新建 Skill | 表单生成 `<DSH_HOME>/skills/<名称>/SKILL.md`。名称需符合 kebab-case，description 与正文必填；同名目录已存在时拒绝写入 |
| 从文件夹导入 | 弹出系统目录选择器。若所选目录含 `SKILL.md`，整个目录按原目录名拷入用户 skill 根；否则把该目录下的平铺 `.md` 逐个拷入。目标已存在时跳过，不覆盖 |
| 打开 skill 目录 | 在系统文件管理器中打开用户 skill 根；点击某条 skill 的「打开位置」则定位到该文件 |
| 重新装回内置 skill | 本插件中始终报告「不适用」，详见下文 |

面板同时展示：

dsh-skill-manager README · 界面与操作：- 按 rank 分组的 skill 列表，每条显示名称、描述、何时使用、来源根、正文大小与正文预览；
- 「随包内置」标记（依据记账文件判定，见下文）；
- 「被忽略的文件」列表，逐条给出 frontmatter 解析失败的原因；
- 一张扫描根目录说明表（rank、路径、目录是否存在）。

dsh-skill-manager README · 关于「重新装回内置 skill」：本插件不适用：官方桌面版**不随插件发行内置 skill**：随包 skill 由运行时自行管理。因此宿主半边把
`BUNDLED_DIR` 固定为 `null`，`POST /skills/restore-bundled` 会明确返回：

> 官方桌面版不随插件发行内置 skill（随包 skill 由运行时自行管理），此项不适用

界面上的按钮保留，但点击后显示的就是上面这句话。列表中的「随包内置」一栏同样始终为空。

`host/services/skills.mjs` 中仍保留了一套完整的随包 skill 安装与记账实现
（`installBundledSkills` / `restoreBundledSkills` / `bundledSkillNames`，
记账文件为 `<DSH_HOME>/bundled-skills/.installed.json`），但在本插件中
`bundledDir` 恒为 `null`，这些函数不会安装任何内容。
section: 关于「重新装回内置 skill」：本插件不适用

text:
dsh-skill-manager README · skill 的发现规则：官方按 rank 顺序扫描以下根目录，同名的 skill 以 rank 较小者为准。每个根只扫描**一层**，
不支持嵌套的 `SKILL.md`：

| rank | 来源 | 路径 | 可写 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 当前项目（`.dsh`） | `<项目根>/.dsh/skills` | 是 |
| 200 | 当前项目（`.agents`） | `<项目根>/.agents/skills` | 是 |
| 400 | 桌面版用户目录 | `<DSH_HOME>/skills` | 是 |
| 500 | 共享 agent 目录 | `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills`（默认 `~/.agents/skills`） | 是 |
| 600 | 随包内置 | 官方 `bundledSkillDir`，本插件不涉及 | 否 |

「项目根」取最近的含 `.git` 的祖先目录（最多向上 24 层），没有则使用当前工作目录。

一个 skill 可以是：

dsh-skill-manager README · skill 的发现规则：- **目录 bundle**：`<名称>/SKILL.md`，可附带 `references/`、`scripts/`、`assets/` 等资源；
- **平铺文件**：`<名称>.md`。

以 `.` 开头的条目会被跳过。`SKILL.md` 必须以 `---` 包裹的 YAML frontmatter 开头：

| 字段 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | 是 | 仅小写字母、数字与短横线（`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`） |
| `description` | 是 | 模型据此决定是否使用该 skill |
| `whenToUse` | 否 | 何时使用 |
| `user-invocable` | 否 | 设为 `false` 时用户不可手动调用 |
| `disable-model-invocation` | 否 | 设为 `true` 时模型不可自动调用 |

dsh-skill-manager README · skill 的发现规则：布尔字段按严格布尔解析：接受 `true` / `false`，也接受 `yes` / `no` / `on` / `off` / `1` / `0`
等字符串写法；其余值视为未设置（与官方一致）。

frontmatter 由 `yaml` 包解析，并且刻意使用**运行时自带的那一份** ——
换用其他 YAML 库可能对边界写法给出不同结论，从而与宿主的判断不一致。

**skill 是热生效的**：新建或导入后无需重启宿主，官方 watcher 会在下一个模型步骤刷新目录。
dsh-skill-manager README · 宿主接口：所有接口挂在 `/dsh-skill-manager/api` 下。

dsh-skill-manager README · 插件自有路由：| 方法 | 路径 | 请求体 | 返回 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/skills/list` | —— | `{ roots, skills, invalid, home, userRoot, bundledDir }` |
| `POST` | `/skills/create` | `{ input }` | `{ path, name }` |
| `POST` | `/skills/import` | `{ sourceDir }` | `{ imported, skipped, root }` |
| `POST` | `/skills/restore-bundled` | —— | 恒为「不适用」错误 |
| `POST` | `/skills/open-dir` | `{ target? }` | `{ opened }`，缺省打开用户 skill 根 |

dsh-skill-manager README · 公共路由：| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/info` | 插件 id、宿主状态、运行时目录等；客户端以 `data.plugin` 判定基址是否可用 |
| `GET` | `/config` | 读取 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-extras.json` |
| `POST` | `/config` | 深合并写回该文件 |
| `POST` | `/open-external` | 用系统默认程序打开 http/https 链接，其他协议一律拒绝 |
| `POST` | `/pick-directory` | 系统目录选择器；优先使用官方 `ctx.directoryPicker`，否则在 Windows 上用 PowerShell 兜底 |
| `GET` | `/restart-pending` | profile 的关键文件是否比宿主就绪时刻更新 |
| `POST` | `/restart-host` | 恒定拒绝：插件无法重启承载自身的进程 |
| `GET` | `/events` | 事件增量拉取（`?since=<seq>`），客户端每 300ms 轮询一次 |

dsh-skill-manager README · 启用条件：- **宿主半边**：包名出现在 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组中，
  且 profile 已重新装载（重启桌面版）。没有环境变量开关。
- **客户端半边**：页面由官方桌面版外壳提供。基址探测成功后界面可用；探测失败时界面仍会渲染，
  但所有数据请求都会失败并显示错误信息。

dsh-skill-manager README · 测试：```bash
npm test

dsh-skill-manager README · 等价于 node test/check.mjs：```

`test/check.mjs` 是纯 Node 自检（35 项），不依赖 DSH 运行时，也不需要把插件装进 profile。
它使用临时 `DSH_HOME` 与临时 `APPDATA`，不会读写用户的真实目录。覆盖范围：

- `package.json` 清单契约：`dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client.platform`、`exports` 与 `files`
  所指向的文件真实存在；
- 宿主半边可被 import，导出 `name` / `inject` / `apply`，`apply(ctx)` 不抛并注册前缀路由；
- **路由对齐**：从 `client.js` 中提取全部 `request("METHOD", "PATH")` 调用（当前 10 条），
  逐条打到真实路由表上，确认没有一条落到 404；同时校验两侧的路由前缀一致；
- `host/config.mjs` 的默认值包含 `githubToken` 等字段，且配置文件路径落在当前 `DSH_HOME` 之下。

dsh-skill-manager README · 等价于 node test/check.mjs：路由对齐是本项目的核心契约：客户端半边是构建产物，一旦它调用的路由在宿主侧不存在，
表现只是界面上某个按钮静默失败（宿主回 404，页面只显示一句笼统的错误）。

端到端验证：装入并重启桌面版后，侧边栏应出现「Skill 管理」入口，面板能列出
`<DSH_HOME>/skills` 下的 skill。

dsh-skill-manager README · 已知限制：- **「重新装回内置 skill」不适用。** 官方桌面版不随插件发行内置 skill，该操作恒定返回错误（详见上文）。
- **宿主无法重启自身。** `POST /restart-host` 恒定拒绝；需要重启时请手动退出并重新打开桌面版。
- **「打开 skill 目录」要求目录已存在。** 若 `<DSH_HOME>/skills` 尚不存在（例如全新安装且从未创建过
  skill），该操作会报「路径不存在」。先用「新建 Skill」或「从文件夹导入」创建一次即可。
- **只扫描一层。** 与官方一致，根目录下的子目录不会被递归查找，嵌套的 `SKILL.md` 不会被发现。
- **不接管加载与卸载。** 扫描、解析、热加载均由官方 `dsh-skill-filesystem` 负责；本插件只做
  文件层面的增删查。界面上「有效 / 被忽略」的判断是对同一套规则的重演，不是另一套判定。
- **导入不覆盖同名文件。** 目标已存在时跳过并在结果中列出；需要覆盖请先手动删除。
- **`client.js` 是构建产物。** 它由构建脚本从桌面版前端源码切片生成，其中包含若干本页未使用的
  组件（安装进度环、README 抽屉、重启提示条、若干图标等，来自同一套切片的其他面板）。
  这些组件不参与本插件的渲染；直接手工修改会在下次构建时被覆盖。
- **界面文案为中文。** 当前版本未做多语言。

**English** | [简体中文](./README.md)

A management UI for DSH skills in the official DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop shell: it lists the
skill roots the host actually scans, marks each skill's origin and validity, creates new skills,
imports them from a folder, and opens directories in the system file manager.

The plugin installs as a standalone bundle into a DSH profile. It does not take over the official
skill scanning or hot-reload path.

dsh-skill-manager README · Background：The official desktop shell already ships a complete skill subsystem, but exposes no UI for it:

| Capability | Provided by | Shipped by default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scan skill roots, parse frontmatter, hot-reload | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` | Yes |
| Invoke skills with `/` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-skill` | Yes |
| List scanned roots, flag invalid files, create and import | —— | **No** |

dsh-skill-manager README · Background：When a frontmatter block is malformed, or a skill simply is not loaded, the only recourse is to
inspect directories and logs by hand.

This plugin fills that gap. It does not participate in loading; it only performs file-level
create / read / import operations, and reports the scanned roots and each skill's origin
faithfully. It therefore coexists with the official plugin without conflict — one loads, the other
manages files.

| DeepSeek Harness | Official desktop build |

dsh-skill-manager README · Installation：Installation has two steps: install into the profile, then register the package name in the bundle
layer stack.

text:
dsh-skill-manager README · Uninstallation：```bash
cd "<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop"
"$NODE" "$PNPM" remove dsh-skill-manager
```

Then delete the `"dsh-skill-manager"` line from `dsh.profile.bundles`. A restart is required here
as well.

Uninstallation **never** deletes skill files: the plugin only writes into `<DSH_HOME>/skills` and
never cleans that directory.

dsh-skill-manager README · How It Works：The plugin consists of two halves that run independently:

| Half | Runs in | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host half | DSH host process (Node.js) | Cordis plugin exporting `name` / `inject` / `apply(ctx)` |
| Client half | Desktop window (browser) | React page loaded via `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` |

dsh-skill-manager README · How It Works：The **host half** registers exactly one `kind: 'prefix'` route on `ctx.webServer`
(`/dsh-skill-manager/api`); dispatching within that prefix is handled by `host/router.mjs`.
This keeps the registration point in one place, and the framework tears it down on unload, leaving
no half-built route table behind.

dsh-skill-manager README · How It Works：Every response is shaped `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error }`, and business failures still
return HTTP 200 — status codes are reserved for transport-level facts such as "no such route".

dsh-skill-manager README · How It Works：The **client half** probes the host base URL on its first request. The page origin may be the host's
own HTTP address, the shell's custom scheme (`dsh-app://app/`), or an opaque origin
(`location.origin === "null"`). It therefore tries a relative path and the official virtual hostname
`http://dsh.internal` in order, and uses the `data.plugin` field returned by `/info` as the
acceptance test — a bare HTTP 200 is not enough, because the SPA fallback route answers unknown
paths with 200 + HTML. The resolved base is then cached.

dsh-skill-manager README · How It Works：**Shared configuration**: the plugin shares `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-extras.json` with its sibling plugins,
reading it via `GET /config` and deep-merging writes via `POST /config`. This plugin defines no
configuration of its own, but `GET /info` carries the file's `appName` field.

**Logging**: the host half writes to `<DSH_HOME>/plugin-data/logs/dsh-skill-manager.log` and keeps
the most recent 2000 lines in an in-memory ring buffer.
dsh-skill-manager README · UI and Operations：The "Skill 管理" entry in the sidebar opens the panel, which offers four operations:

dsh-skill-manager README · UI and Operations：| Operation | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Create skill | The form writes `<DSH_HOME>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. The name must be kebab-case; description and body are required; an existing directory of the same name is rejected |
| Import from folder | Opens the system directory picker. If the chosen folder contains `SKILL.md`, the whole folder is copied into the user skill root under its own name; otherwise every flat `.md` file in it is copied. Existing targets are skipped, never overwritten |
| Open skill directory | Opens the user skill root in the system file manager; the per-skill "打开位置" button reveals that specific file |
| Restore bundled skills | Always reports "not applicable" in this plugin — see below |

dsh-skill-manager README · "Restore bundled skills" is not applicable here：The official desktop build **does not ship bundled skills through plugins**: bundled skills are
managed by the runtime itself. The host half therefore pins `BUNDLED_DIR` to `null`, and
`POST /skills/restore-bundled` answers with:

> 官方桌面版不随插件发行内置 skill（随包 skill 由运行时自行管理），此项不适用
> *(The official desktop build does not ship bundled skills through plugins — bundled skills are
> managed by the runtime — so this operation is not applicable.)*

dsh-skill-manager README · "Restore bundled skills" is not applicable here：The button remains in the UI; clicking it shows exactly that message. The "bundled" tag in the
skill list is likewise always empty here.

`host/services/skills.mjs` still contains a complete bundled-skill install and ledger implementation
(`installBundledSkills` / `restoreBundledSkills` / `bundledSkillNames`, ledger at
`<DSH_HOME>/bundled-skills/.installed.json`), but since `bundledDir` is always `null` in this plugin,
those functions install nothing.

text:
dsh-skill-manager README · Skill Discovery Rules：The official implementation scans the following roots in rank order; for duplicate names the lower
rank wins. Each root is scanned exactly **one level deep** — nested `SKILL.md` files are not
supported:

dsh-skill-manager README · Skill Discovery Rules：| rank | Origin | Path | Writable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | Current project (`.dsh`) | `<project root>/.dsh/skills` | Yes |
| 200 | Current project (`.agents`) | `<project root>/.agents/skills` | Yes |
| 400 | Desktop user directory | `<DSH_HOME>/skills` | Yes |
| 500 | Shared agent directory | `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` (default `~/.agents/skills`) | Yes |
| 600 | Bundled | Official `bundledSkillDir`; not used by this plugin | No |

dsh-skill-manager README · Skill Discovery Rules：The "project root" is the nearest ancestor directory containing `.git` (at most 24 levels up),
falling back to the current working directory.

A skill is either:

- a **directory bundle**: `<name>/SKILL.md`, optionally alongside `references/`, `scripts/`,
  `assets/` and similar resources;
- or a **flat file**: `<name>.md`.

Entries starting with `.` are skipped. `SKILL.md` must begin with a YAML frontmatter block delimited
by `---`:

dsh-skill-manager README · Skill Discovery Rules：| Field | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`) |
| `description` | Yes | Used by the model to decide whether to use the skill |
| `whenToUse` | No | When to use it |
| `user-invocable` | No | `false` disables manual invocation |
| `disable-model-invocation` | No | `true` disables automatic invocation by the model |

dsh-skill-manager README · Skill Discovery Rules：Boolean fields are parsed strictly: `true` / `false` are accepted, as are the string forms
`yes` / `no` / `on` / `off` / `1` / `0`. Any other value counts as unset (matching the official
behaviour).

Frontmatter is parsed with the `yaml` package — deliberately the **same copy the runtime ships**.
A different YAML library can reach different conclusions on edge-case syntax and would then
disagree with the host.

dsh-skill-manager README · Skill Discovery Rules：**Skills are hot-effective**: after creating or importing one, no host restart is needed; the
official watcher refreshes the directory on the next model step.
dsh-skill-manager README · Host API：All routes live under `/dsh-skill-manager/api`.

dsh-skill-manager README · Plugin routes：| Method | Path | Request body | Response |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/skills/list` | —— | `{ roots, skills, invalid, home, userRoot, bundledDir }` |
| `POST` | `/skills/create` | `{ input }` | `{ path, name }` |
| `POST` | `/skills/import` | `{ sourceDir }` | `{ imported, skipped, root }` |
| `POST` | `/skills/restore-bundled` | —— | Always a "not applicable" error |
| `POST` | `/skills/open-dir` | `{ target? }` | `{ opened }`; defaults to the user skill root |
dsh-skill-manager README · Common routes：The following routes are provided by `host/router.mjs` (this plugin's page uses only a subset):

dsh-skill-manager README · Common routes：| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/info` | Plugin id, host state, runtime directory, etc. The client uses `data.plugin` to accept a base URL |
| `GET` | `/config` | Read `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-extras.json` |
| `POST` | `/config` | Deep-merge and write that file |
| `POST` | `/open-external` | Open an http/https URL with the system default handler; all other protocols are refused |
| `POST` | `/pick-directory` | System directory picker; prefers the official `ctx.directoryPicker`, otherwise falls back to PowerShell on Windows |
| `GET` | `/restart-pending` | Whether key profile files are newer than the host's ready timestamp |
| `POST` | `/restart-host` | Always refuses: a plugin cannot restart the process that hosts it |
| `GET` | `/events` | Incremental event fetch (`?since=<seq>`); the client polls every 300 ms |

dsh-skill-manager README · Activation Criteria：- **Host half**: the package name is present in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` array and the
  profile has been reloaded (desktop shell restarted). There is no environment-variable switch.
- **Client half**: the page is served by the official desktop shell. Once base-URL probing succeeds
  the UI is usable; if probing fails the UI still renders, but every data request fails with an
  error message.

dsh-skill-manager README · Testing：```bash
npm test

dsh-skill-manager README · equivalent to node test/check.mjs：```

`test/check.mjs` is a pure Node self-check (35 cases). It does not depend on the DSH runtime and does
not require the plugin to be installed into a profile. It uses a temporary `DSH_HOME` and a temporary
`APPDATA`, so it never touches the user's real directories. It covers:

dsh-skill-manager README · equivalent to node test/check.mjs：Route alignment is the core contract of this project: the client half is a build artefact, and if a
route it calls does not exist on the host side, the only symptom is a button that fails silently
(the host answers 404 while the page shows a generic error).

End-to-end verification: after installing and restarting the desktop shell, a "Skill 管理" entry
should appear in the sidebar, and the panel should list the skills under `<DSH_HOME>/skills`.

dsh-skill-manager README · Known Limitations：- **"Restore bundled skills" is not applicable.** The official desktop build does not ship bundled
  skills through plugins, so the operation always returns an error (see above).
- **The host cannot restart itself.** `POST /restart-host` always refuses; restart the desktop shell
  manually when needed.
- **"Open skill directory" requires the directory to exist.** If `<DSH_HOME>/skills` does not exist
  yet (a fresh install with no skills ever created), the operation reports a missing path. Create one
  via "Create skill" or "Import from folder" first.
- **Single-level scan only.** As with the official implementation, subdirectories of a root are not
  searched recursively, and nested `SKILL.md` files are never found.
- **No loading or unloading.** Scanning, parsing and hot-reloading all belong to the official
  `dsh-skill-filesystem`. This plugin only performs file-level operations. The "valid / ignored"
  verdicts shown in the UI replay the same rules; they are not a second source of truth.
- **Import never overwrites.** Existing targets are skipped and reported in the result; delete them
  manually first if you want to replace them.
